course.title: Unit 3 My School【例句】
course.description: SECTION A What is your school like?

sentences.content: It's in front of the art building.
sentences.english: It's in front of the art building

sentences.content: Is there a student centre in this school?
sentences.english: Is there a student centre in this school ?
sentences.chinese: 这所学校有学生中心吗？

sentences.content: It's between the library and the gym.
sentences.english: It's between the library and the gym
sentences.chinese: 它在图书馆和体育馆之间。

sentences.content: What's your new classroom like, Peter?
sentences.english: What's your new classroom like , Peter ?

sentences.content: There are 40 student desks in the room.
sentences.english: There are 40 student desks in the room

sentences.content: And a teacher's desk in front of the blackboard.
sentences.english: And a teacher's desk in front of the blackboard

sentences.content: I sit in the middle of the classroom.
sentences.english: I sit in the middle of the classroom

sentences.chinese: 你的教室里有什么特别之处？

sentences.content: There's a smart whiteboard next to the blackboard.
sentences.english: There's a smart whiteboard next to the blackboard
sentences.chinese: 黑板旁边有一块智能白板。

sentences.content: There's another blackboard at the back of the classroom.
sentences.english: There's another blackboard at the back of the classroom
sentences.chinese: 教室后面还有一块黑板。

sentences.content: We put up important notices there.
sentences.english: We put up important notices there
sentences.chinese: 我们把重要通知张贴在那里。

sentences.content: Are there any lockers in the classroom?
sentences.english: Are there any lockers in the classroom ?

sentences.content: We put our things in the desk drawers.
sentences.english: We put our things in the desk drawers
sentences.chinese: 我们把东西放进了书桌抽屉里。
